fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Choose your WhatsApp gateway. The credential fields change to match the provider you pick. Default: WhatsHub360.

fields.label: API Base URL (optional override)
fields.description: Leave BLANK to use the selected provider's default API URL. Only set this if your provider gave you a custom host. WhatsHub360 default: https://app.whatshub360.com/api

fields.label: API Token
fields.description: REQUIRED to send. WhatsHub360: your API Access Token (sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'). Airtel IQ: the Basic-auth token = base64('username:password'). Stored encrypted.

fields.label: Vendor UID (WhatsHub360)
fields.description: REQUIRED for WhatsHub360. Your Vendor UID — it forms part of the send URL (/api/<vendor_uid>/contact/send-template-message). Example: 9f8e7d6c-1234-4abc-9def-0123456789ab

fields.label: From Phone Number Id (WhatsHub360, optional)
fields.description: Optional (WhatsHub360). The phone-number id to send FROM; if blank, your account's default sender is used.

fields.label: App Id (Airtel IQ)
fields.description: REQUIRED for Airtel IQ. The 'app-id' header value Airtel issues for your account. Example: 1234567890123456

fields.label: Sender Number (Airtel IQ)
fields.description: REQUIRED for Airtel IQ. Registered WhatsApp Business / sender number — country code + 10 digits, NO '+'. Example: 919812345678

fields.label: WABA Id (Airtel IQ)
fields.description: Airtel IQ only. WhatsApp Business Account id. Used by the Template Designer (Phase 3); not needed to send.

fields.label: Customer Id (Airtel IQ)
fields.description: Airtel IQ only. Used by the in-app Template Designer (Phase 3); not needed to send.

fields.label: Sub-Account Id (Airtel IQ)
fields.description: Airtel IQ only. Used by the Template Designer (Phase 3); not needed to send.
